glance_takeaway: This is a project dossier for 'murmur' — teaching a small classifier to hear one bird through cheap, physically-plausible noise. After 6 experiments the verdict is 'Partially supported': cheap reverb-flavoured augmentation lifted validation macro-F1 from 0.612 to 0.671 (+5.9 pts) at almost no extra compute (<1 min per run), but most of the gain lands on common/mid species — the rare tail barely moves (deepest-tail class, Kirtland's Warbler with 41 clips, is at 0.33, slightly below baseline). Not every augmentation helped (pitch/time stretch regressed to 0.589, below baseline); the best result is a stack of tricks, and the next move is class-conditional augmentation.
